searchText: Does anyone know if one can run validators on sepolia? Yes sir How can I get myself whitelisted to run validators on sepolia? And does sepolia have a deposit contract for validator activation?? In general, you cannot. Sepolia runs with a minimal set of validators and is designed to run a stable environment where users can tests out dapps and other execution layer items. If you want to run a validator you should do so on holesky. Thanks for clarifying! One of the clients had their testnet on sepolia and they wanted to test enabling staking.
